proposals.idea: Pair rendered images from different time steps to force the model to distinguish static geometry (which should match memory) from dynamic content (which should follow current context).
proposals.setting: When conditioning on keyframes from revisited locations, deliberately introduce temporal offset between the conditioning frame's timestamp and the current generation step to prevent naive replay of stale object positions.

proposals.idea: Selectively expose subject and scene queries to history through different routing policies to prevent background/viewpoint locking while maintaining subject consistency.
proposals.setting: Implement differential gain scheduling on attention cache: apply higher retention weight to subject-relevant tokens in the rolling window while allowing scene tokens to decay faster, enabling viewpoint progression without full memory reset.
proposals.source_title: Tether the Subject, Release the Scene: Query-Aware Memory Routing for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation

proposals.technique: Deep Sink with Importance-Aware KV Cache Pruning
proposals.idea: Maintain an enlarged attention sink in KV cache while pruning redundant tokens based on actual attention patterns, preventing both memory degradation and motion stagnation.
proposals.setting: Increase permanent frames in attention cache to ~50% of KV cache size and implement importance-weighted pruning of rolling window tokens based on attention weights, evicting low-attention tokens between chunks.
proposals.source_title: 🚨The code for our paper “Deep Forcing: Training-Free Long Video Generation with Deep Sink and Participative Compression” is now available! | Jung Yi
proposals.already_tested: gain 2-1000 on the first frames, a heading-indexed bank, windows of 30-42 frames (frames, no gain)

proposals.idea: Counteract low-frequency energy drift (color/motion degradation) by anchoring frequency-domain statistics of generated chunks to reference spectral signatures.
proposals.setting: Shift each chunk's latents toward reference statistics in the frequency domain, specifically boosting low-frequency component magnitudes to prevent color drift and motion stagnation in long rollouts.
proposals.source_title: FreqForcing: Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring | alphaXiv

proposals.technique: Echo-Forcing (Scene Memory Framework with separated KV cache policies)
proposals.idea: Separate the attention cache into stable anchors (old frames) and recent dynamics (new frames) with independent policies to prevent outdated background contamination when scenes change.
proposals.setting: Split the rolling window into two independent cache tracks: a fixed set of early permanent frames (anchor branch) and a shorter recent window (local branch), with separate gain scheduling for each; merge them at decode time.
proposals.source_title: Echo-Forcing: A Scene Memory Framework for Interactive ...
proposals.already_tested: gain 2-1000 on the first frames, a heading-indexed bank, windows of 30-42 frames (frames, no gain)

proposals.idea: Fuse local attention outputs with frozen anchor frames in the frequency domain (via 3D FFT) to smooth transitions and prevent hard cuts by blending spatial-temporal low-frequency components.
proposals.setting: Add a frequency-domain blending direction to the residual stream: after computing local and anchor attention branches separately, weight and fuse their residuals in frequency space using a spatial-temporal Gaussian low-pass filter, injecting this blend back at mid-to-late decoder blocks.
proposals.source_title: FreqForcing: Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring · Pith
proposals.already_tested: alive direction on sampling steps 0-1 (judged, lowers scores) and ablation (frames, colour cast)

proposals.technique: Memory Retrieval (Context-as-Memory with selective historical conditioning)
proposals.idea: Selectively retrieve and condition on relevant historical frames from context instead of naively concatenating all history, reducing discontinuity artifacts when scene transitions occur.
proposals.setting: Before each chunk, retrieve the most contextually relevant historical frames (e.g., via similarity to current latents) and pin them as keyframe conditioning inputs at the first few positions, replacing uniform context concatenation.
proposals.source_title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval
proposals.already_tested: keyframe arrival on the first frame (frames, clean, rarely triggers) and on a shadow-world frame (being judged)

proposals.setting: Pin conditioning frames at chunk boundaries using visibility masks, ensuring only geometrically feasible regions constrain the model's camera-aware representations.

proposals.idea: Weight intermediate camera poses by confidence scores to avoid noisy pose projections that derail trajectory execution.
proposals.setting: Fork generation at decision points where camera pose confidence is low, run parallel rollouts with interpolated poses, and select the trajectory with highest consistency to target poses.
proposals.source_title: ConfCtrl: Enabling Precise Camera Control in Video Diffusion via Confidence-Aware Interpolation
